units.rawText: No! I-I came to help draw them away! If, just if I can just lure them into my trap...

spans.text: No! I-I came to help draw them away! If, just if I can just lure them into my trap...

units.rawText: <size=28>I, I knew it, they have some level of intelligence, they prioritize attacking agents with healing equipment loaded with operands...</size>

units.rawText: The Entropics on the outer edge of the group were largely spared Erika's attacks and they move far faster than Dushevnaya expected. They have already closed the gap to her before she could think of a distance that will both draw them to the trap and keep her safe.

units.rawText: Don't be distracted during your punishment!

units.rawText: Don't just stand there, Dushevnaya! Run! Weren't you going to lead them into a trap!?
units.displayText: Don't just stand there, Dushevnaya! Run! Weren't you going to lead them into a trap!?

spans.text: Don't just stand there, Dushevnaya! Run! Weren't you going to lead them into a trap!?

units.rawText: Don't be afraid. Since you're here, I'll help keep them off balance! "Don't look back, and don't stop anywhere in the plain!"
units.displayText: Don't be afraid. Since you're here, I'll help keep them off balance! "Don't look back, and don't stop anywhere in the plain!"

units.displayText: Yes! I can do it... I can do it too!

spans.text: Yes! I can do it... I can do it too!

units.rawText: That familiar Bible verse shakes Dushevnaya out of her daze at being beset by the Entropics.
